# Vesper

> Vesper (vesper.codes) is an AI front desk for service businesses in Nepal. It answers customer messages on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger 24/7, checks real calendar availability, and books appointments. It is built in Kathmandu, Nepal by founder Samrat Ghimire.

## Is Vesper (vesper.codes) the same as other products named Vesper?

No. Vesper at vesper.codes is built in Kathmandu, Nepal and works on WhatsApp, Instagram and Messenger messages with real calendar booking. It is not affiliated with Vesper AI by Lyfework (vesper.lyfework.io, a US voice-call receptionist), Vesper Code (vespercode.com, a coding assistant), or VesperOps.

## What it does

- Answers customer questions about services, prices and availability using the business's own approved information
- Books, reschedules and cancels appointments against real availability, with Google Calendar sync
- Understands English, Nepali and Romanized Nepali
- Hands the conversation to a human staff member when needed
- Takes booking deposits through eSewa and Khalti
- Built for salons, clinics, hotels and guesthouses, garages, and other appointment-driven businesses

## Channels

- WhatsApp (official Meta Cloud API)
- Instagram Direct Messages
- Facebook Messenger
- Website chat widget
- TikTok messages: coming soon (not live yet)

Vesper does not answer phone calls.

## Pricing (NPR, per month)

- Starter: Rs. 4,999
- Pro: Rs. 11,999
- Business: Rs. 19,999
